scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol && tsc --noEmit -p apps/host && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/relay && tsc --noEmit -p apps/cli && tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop
scripts.desktop: cd apps/desktop && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE= bun run dev
scripts.desktop:package: cd apps/desktop && bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false bunx electron-builder
scripts.desktop:e2e: cd apps/desktop && bun run build && node test/e2e.ts
